name: KK153 (Hubble)
blurb: KK153, a gas-rich ultra-faint dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: kk153-hubble
story: A faint, gas-rich dwarf galaxy in the Local Group or its outskirts, spotted by the FAST telescope. Hubble's snapshot resolves its stars to pin down how far away it really is.

claims.text: KK153 lies at RA 12h35m01.7s, Dec +58 23 11.8 (matches the pointing)
KK153 is a gas-rich ultra-faint dwarf galaxy in the Local Group or its outskirts
KK153 was discovered as a gas-rich dwarf with FAST
LEDA-41920 is a target of Hubble program 18070, which resolves stars to measure distances
